title: Product Manager
jobDescription:
The person will be managing the Lenskart 's products and primarily be responsible for ensuring that the product is aligned with the short term tactical and long terms strategic goals of the company. You will be working with an experienced team of engineers, content writers, animators and designers to take the product through multiple successful releases. The following crisply defines our philosophy of Product Management and describes our "Ideal Product Manager" Your product strategy and vision are most effective when they are substantiated with real user interactions and data analytics A list of 10 items for the next release with a clear sense of priority will go a long way to ensure that the release is both effective and on-time
3. While working closely with Engineering, Content developers and other product managers it is crucial to identify dependencies early on for a smooth release
4. You know from the bottom of your heart that a PRD that speaks out the user’s needs and wants is the best way to ensure internal buy-in and super high productivity levels
5. A simple annotated wireframe is much better than a 5 page PRD
6. A PRD that is more than 5 pages will not be read
7. A feature no matter how great it sounds, is a true success only when it can be measured
8. Not all your features will be a runaway success and will need constant fine-tuning on an iterative basis
9. In spirit, you are the CEO of your product.

title: CEO Office
jobDescription:
Why This Role Exists This is the most demanding and most rewarding role in the CEO Office. You will be the force that brings clarity, speed, discipline, and intelligence to the entire company. You will help the CEO operate at 10x
- and, in doing so, help Lenskart operate at 100x. This is NOT a coordinator role. This is NOT a typical Chief of Staff role. This is a career-defining, high-velocity, outcome-obsessed role for someone who wants to change how companies work in an AI-first world. Who You Are (Must-Haves) You are someone who is:
1. Humble. Truly humble.
- Ego-free. Comfortable saying “I don’t know.”
- Hungry to learn
- not just every week… but every hour, every minute, every second.
- Learning is your oxygen.
2. A Fast Learner
- You pick up new tools, industries, numbers, and problems at lightning speed.
- What takes others 2 weeks takes you 2 days.
- What takes others 2 days takes you 2 hours.
3. A World-Class Executor
- You get things done.
- You don’t need follow-up
- you follow up.
- You move projects from idea → plan → execution → outcome with discipline and speed.
4. AI-Native
- You use AI like it’s your second brain
- analysis, writing, planning, automation, research.
- You know how to get 10x done with 1x effort.
5. Sharp with Data
- Numbers are your language.
- You can interpret financials, model scenarios, and derive insights quickly and accurately.
6. Exceptional with People
- High EQ.
- Strong influence.
- Kind, empathetic, but firm.
- Teams trust you — and senior leaders respect you.
7. Incredible Communicator
- Crisp. Structured. Clear.
- You can turn chaos into clarity and complexity into simplicity.
8. A Builder of Order
- You bring structure, governance, and discipline to a high-speed environment. You turn confusion into alignment and meetings into decisions.
9. All-In Mindset
- Flexible to travel.
- Available on weekends when required.
- Committed to outcomes, not hours. And above all…
10. A Good Human Being
- Hardworking.
- Honest.
- Respectful.
- Curious.
- Grounded.
- And driven by purpose
- not ego. Key Responsibilities
1. Program-Manage the Entire CEO Office
- Own every key project across functions.
- Track progress, remove roadblocks, ensure delivery.
- Create clarity, structure, and accountability company-wide.
2. Drive Execution Excellence
- Align senior leaders, push teams, escalate when needed.
- Maintain high-speed, high-quality execution cadence.
- Be the CEO’s “execution engine.”
3. Think Strategically
- Break down complex problems with logic & first principles.
- Analyze business performance deeply and link insights to P&L.
4. Run an AI-First Office
- Use AI heavily for research, planning, automation, and analysis.
- Build AI-driven workflows and embed an AI-first mindset across teams.
5. Communication & Leadership Enablement
- Craft CEO updates, board materials, and strategic notes.
- Bring clarity, drive decision-making, and ensure follow-through.
6. High-EQ Partnership
- Keep the CEO focused on what matters most.
- Provide perspective, challenge respectfully, and stabilize chaos. Why This Role Matters If you can operate at this level
- think fast, learn fast, execute fast, influence well, stay humble, and harness AI
- you have the chance to make massive impact. You will:
- Shape how a global company runs.
- Work directly with the CEO every day.
- Lead and influence senior leaders.
- Change how teams think and collaborate.
- Help build one of the most admired AI-first consumer companies in the world.
- This role is a launchpad. To impact. To leadership. To entrepreneurship. To building something iconic. Very few roles offer this kind of exposure, speed, and influence. This is one of them. --- If You’re Exceptional, Apply. If you want a comfortable job, this isn’t for you. If you want a job that challenges you, grows you, stretches you, and puts you in the arena
- this is the one. If you want a chance to change the world, start here.

title: Online Product & Revenue Leader
jobDescription:
Mission Brief: Own the World's Most Intelligent Online Eyewear Business This is not a conventional e-commerce leadership role. This is your opportunity to architect and own the entire digital growth engine of a global eyewear tech company — one that is redefining how hundreds of millions of people experience vision care. As the Global Online Product & Revenue Leader , you will own the full Online P&L across India and Lenskart's international markets, and you will build the AI-powered commercial machine that drives it. You will move us from campaign-driven growth to a real-time, intelligence-led revenue system — where every rupee of media spend, every digital touchpoint, and every customer interaction is optimised by data and AI. Your mandate: make Lenskart the most commercially effective and customer-obsessed digital eyewear brand on the planet. 🔑 Core Mandate
1. Own the P&L. Define the Roadmap. Take full end-to-end ownership of the Online P&L across all channels and geographies — India, Southeast Asia, the Middle East, and beyond. Build and execute a forward-looking online growth roadmap that works backward from deep consumer insight, not internal assumptions. Integrate marketplace and quick commerce into the core business architecture — not as side channels, but as scaled, intelligent revenue streams.
2. Build an AI-First Performance Marketing Engine Lead the transformation of Lenskart's performance marketing from manual optimisation to an AI-driven acquisition and retention engine — across Meta, Google, Programmatic, Affiliates, and emerging channels. Deploy sophisticated LTV-based audience modelling, predictive cohort targeting, and AI-powered bidding strategies to maximise return on every dollar of media spend. Develop and own the frameworks for AI-assisted creative testing and real-time campaign optimisation at scale. Scale marketplace and quick commerce presence through intelligent catalogue management, algorithmic ranking strategies, and demand-signal-driven inventory positioning.
3. Lead a Global Online Team Provide strategic direction and operational clarity to regional online channel teams across markets. Ensure each market accelerates its own growth trajectory while staying coherent with global brand, tech, and operational standards. Build a team culture where speed, data fluency, and customer obsession are non-negotiable defaults.
4. Drive AI-Powered Product & Experience Innovation Partner with Product and Tech to embed AI deeply into the customer journey — from intelligent search and personalised recommendations to virtual try-on and AI-led conversion optimisation. Champion a culture of continuous experimentation: own the A/B testing roadmap, accelerate learning velocity, and ensure every insight compounds into measurable conversion and retention uplift. Define and deliver the digital experience standard that makes Lenskart's web and app not just functional — but genuinely delightful and differentiated.
5. Turn Data Into Decisions, at Speed Build and operate a real-time performance intelligence system — dashboards, funnels, cohort analyses — that enables the team to make high-quality decisions in hours, not weeks. Own growth forecasting, customer segmentation, and hyper-targeted audience strategies that power scalable, profitable marketing. Move the organisation from reactive reporting to predictive, AI-assisted growth operations.
6. Connect the Entire Value Chain Work hand-in-hand with Supply Chain, Category, CX, Merchandising, and Creative to ensure every online touchpoint is backed by seamless operational execution. Be the connective tissue between commercial ambition and operational reality — ensuring the customer experience is consistent, compelling, and continuously improving. The Essentials Commercial Ownership at Scale: You have held full P&L accountability for a large-scale digital business — and you have delivered aggressive, sustainable revenue growth while managing cost discipline. AI & Data Fluency: You don't just commission data analyses — you understand how AI and ML can be applied to performance marketing, personalisation, forecasting, and customer experience. You've either built or led teams that have deployed these capabilities in production. Performance Marketing Depth: You have managed large, complex media budgets across search and social, and you have led the shift from manual to algorithmic and AI-assisted campaign management. Multi-channel Architecture: You have scaled revenue across owned digital channels (web, app), third-party marketplaces, and rapid-delivery platforms — simultaneously, not sequentially. Customer Experience Instinct: You obsess over the digital journey. You can identify friction at a granular level and move fast to eliminate it — using data, design, and product thinking together. Cross-functional Influence: You have a track record of aligning supply chain, creative, and engineering teams behind a single commercial vision — across geographies and cultures. The Mindset Builder, not Manager. You are energised by the opportunity to construct something new — a smarter, faster, more intelligent online business — not just to optimise what already exists. AI-Native Thinker. You see AI not as a feature to add, but as the foundational layer through which growth is designed. You are curious about what is possible, and you move fast to test it. Commercially Fearless. You are comfortable with ambitious targets and the accountability that comes with them. You set the bar high for yourself and for your team. Customer-Backward. You make every strategic decision by starting with the customer — their needs, their friction points, their moments of delight — and working backwards to the business model. Globally Curious. You thrive in multi-market complexity. You understand that what works in one market is a hypothesis in another, and you build systems that can learn and adapt. Lenskart is on a mission to make quality eyewear accessible to everyone on the planet. If you want to build the digital engine that powers that mission — and you're ready to do it with AI at the centre — we want to meet you. Job requirements P&L Responsibility: A proven history of managing the complete income and expense statement for a large-scale digital business, with a focus on sustainable profit and aggressive revenue growth. Product-Driven Customer Experience: The ability to lead technical teams to build digital features that simplify complex buying decisions, such as virtual fitting tools and seamless try-on experiences. Strategic Marketing Oversight: Expertise in managing large advertising budgets across search engines and social media, ensuring the cost to acquire a customer is balanced against their long-term value. Multichannel Distribution: Practical experience scaling sales through company-owned websites, mobile applications, third-party marketplaces, and rapid-delivery platforms. Customer Experience focus: The skill to analyze complex customer data to identify friction points in the digital journey and implement rapid improvements to drive customer experience online. Cross-Functional Leadership: A track record of aligning diverse departments—including supply chain, creative design, and engineering—to ensure a consistent customer experience across different global regions.

title: Merchandising Growth Leader
jobDescription:
Lenskart is a design-led technology company reimagining how the world sees. Job Overview We're seeking a Merchandising Growth Leader to join Lenskart. This is a backfill role that has been open for some time, and we're eager to find the right candidate to drive growth through strategic merchandising initiatives. Team Culture & What Makes This Role Unique This role is a unique blend of strategy, operations, and business leadership. You'll leverage strategic thinking and translate it into real-time problem solving for the business. The opportunities are wide open—you're not limited to merchandising supply chain practices alone. Any initiative that can facilitate consumer demand growth is on the table, making it a dynamic and expansive environment to innovate and lead. Key Responsibilities Drive company growth by incorporating and understanding customer-level insights at every sales touchpoint. Build these insights into the merchandising supply chain ecosystem, including:
- Demand planning
- Supply planning
- Vendor planning
- Capacity planning
- Store assortment planning for each individual location Create a seamless ecosystem where supply and demand are in sync, with demand planning driven from consumer needs backward. Ensure this consumer-backward approach is applied across all sales channels, including:
- In-store
- Online
- Marketplace
- Home try-on Build an end-to-end infrastructure for a seamless merchandising supply chain that makes the design-to-shelf process highly efficient, reduces lead times, and ensures optimal product availability and inventory management. Implement intelligent systems inspired by best practices from leading brands like Zara and Uniqlo. Must-Have Requirements Experience: You have 10+ years of experience in high-growth environments. You’ve managed global teams and know how to navigate the chaos of a company that moves at light speed. Expertise in building end-to-end systems, ideally within supply chain or merchandising processes, with strong problem-solving skills. Leadership: You don't just "manage" a department; you build a culture. You have a track record of identifying raw talent, mentoring future leaders, and keeping a high-performance team motivated in a high-pressure, fast-moving environment. Design-Obsessed: You likely have a background in design or creative direction. You understand materials, ergonomics, and why a certain frame shape works (or doesn't). Data-Fluent: You don’t need a dashboard to tell you what's happening. You’re comfortable diving into the numbers yourself to find the "why" behind the sales. A Systems Thinker: You don't just fix a problem once; you build a system so it never happens again. You are always thinking about how to make things 10x more efficient. Growth Mindset: You’re never "done." You’re constantly looking for better ways to do things, whether that’s through new tech, better math, or smarter design. Nice-to-Have Skills Ability to leverage new-age technology for innovative problem solving. Deep understanding of how to grow consumer demand and maintain close contact with consumers. Consultancy experience in driving consumer growth through the right market drivers. Location & Travel Based in the Delhi NCR office. Involves travel to various geographies to understand consumer and business requirements.

title: Business Finance Partner - Supply Chain
jobDescription: Business Finance Partner – Supply Chain Lenskart.com | Haryana, India | On-site | Full-time Mission Brief: Build the Financial Brain of a Global Supply Chain Lenskart's supply chain is one of the most complex and fast-moving in consumer-tech — spanning procurement, manufacturing, and last-mile delivery across India, Southeast Asia, and the Middle East. We manage billions in inventory, run vertically integrated manufacturing at scale, and are aggressively building towards a real-time, AI-driven supply chain. This role is the financial intelligence layer that makes all of it smarter. As our Supply Chain Business Finance Partner, you won't just report numbers — you will define the decisioning architecture that governs how we invest, cut cost, and scale. You will sit at the intersection of finance, operations, and technology, turning data into conviction and conviction into action. This is a builder's role for a systems thinker who sees finance as a product, not a function. 🎯 Core Mandate: What You Will Build & Drive Financial Architecture for a World-Class Supply Chain Own the end-to-end financial blueprint of our supply chain — from AOP to real-time cost intelligence. You will design the planning frameworks, KPI systems, and forecasting models that link every operational driver to financial outcomes. Move us from periodic reviews to always-on financial visibility. Cost Leadership & Margin Intelligence Drive cost-to-serve reduction and margin expansion across procurement, manufacturing, and logistics. You won't just track costs — you will build the analytical models that identify where inefficiencies hide, quantify the opportunity, and drive structural interventions with supply chain leaders. Every basis point matters at our scale. Building the AI-First Financial Intelligence Layer Lead the design and deployment of automated financial dashboards, predictive cost models, and real-time variance engines. Work directly with data engineers and BI teams to replace static spreadsheets with live, insight-led decision tools. Your north star: no supply chain decision at Lenskart should be made without a financial model behind it. Investment & Capital Allocation Be the financial architect for every major capex decision — automation investments, network expansion, manufacturing capacity. Build robust ROI frameworks and scenario models that give leadership the confidence to bet big and the discipline to kill what doesn't work. Working Capital & Cash Intelligence Own inventory efficiency as a financial mandate. Build models that connect buying decisions to cash flow outcomes, reduce obsolescence, and drive smarter Open-to-Buy strategies. Turn working capital from a lagging metric into a leading lever. Cross-Functional Business Partnering Operate as a true business partner — embedded with supply chain, procurement, and operations leaders. Bring financial structure to strategic conversations, challenge assumptions with data, and ensure every major supply chain decision is grounded in rigorous financial thinking. The Essentials CA / MBA with 10–15 years in business finance or FP&A, with meaningful exposure to supply chain, operations, or manufacturing environments. Experience in consumer, retail, e-commerce, FMCG, or manufacturing-led businesses. Strong command of financial modeling, cost structures, performance analytics, and ERP/BI ecosystems. 🧠 The Mindset — This Is What Sets You Apart Systems Thinker: You see the supply chain as an interconnected system, not a set of line items. You build financial models that reflect operational reality, not just accounting logic. AI-First Operator: You are impatient with manual processes. You default to automation, data pipelines, and predictive models. You know your way around BI tools, ERP systems, and data layers — and you push your teams to build, not just report. Builder's Instinct: You leave things better than you found them. You are not here to maintain — you are here to architect, scale, and continuously improve the financial infrastructure of a global supply chain. Bias for Impact: You move fast, prioritize ruthlessly, and measure yourself by outcomes — cost saved, margin improved, decisions accelerated. You are equally comfortable in the boardroom and the warehouse floor. Why This Role Changes Your Career In two years, you will have built the financial operating system for one of the world's most ambitious supply chains. You will have worked alongside founders and senior leaders, made decisions that moved hundreds of millions in cost and capital, and created infrastructure that outlasts you. This is not a finance role with a supply chain flavour. This is a leadership mandate at the heart of Lenskart's global growth engine. Why Lenskart — Right Now We are scaling across India, SEA, and the Middle East at a pace most companies never experience. We are building proprietary technology, vertically integrated manufacturing, and AI-driven operations — all at the same time. The people who join us now will define what Lenskart becomes. If you are a finance leader who thinks like a founder, builds like an engineer, and moves like an operator — this role was written for you.

Technical Depth: Strong expertise in design execution, BOQs, contracting, vendor governance, and engineering oversight — combined with a genuine appetite for using data and technology to make project delivery smarter and faster. Scale: Demonstrated experience managing large retail portfolios across multiple geographies, with the ability to balance local nuance with global consistency.

EDUCATION:
Bachelor's degree in Architecture or Civil Engineering. title: Database Reliability Engineer Sql and MongoDB
jobDescription:
The Role We are looking for a high‐caliber Data Ops / Database Reliability Engineer who brings strong engineering fundamentals and a deep sense of ownership. You will design, build, and operate My SQL, Mongo DB, MSSQL, and Big Query platforms that enable product teams to ship quickly and safely
- at scale. This role is hands‐on, impact‐driven, and aligned with top‐tier engineering standards. What You Will Do Database Architecture & Reliability ● Architect and operate highly available My SQL (Inno DB Cluster, Group Replication), Mongo DB (Replica Sets, Sharded Clusters), MSSQL, and Big Query environments. ● Lead migrations (version upgrades, cloud transitions to AWS RDS/Aurora, Mongo DB Atlas, Big Query). ● Define and enforce standards, schema design best practices, and governance policies. ● Drive SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets for mission‐critical data services. Performance Engineering ● Optimize queries, indexes, and workloads using advanced profiling tools across My SQL, Mongo DB, MSSQL, and Big Query. ● Tune Inno DB internals, buffer pools, shard keys, working sets, and query execution plans. ● Resolve bottlenecks across CPU, memory, and I/O. ● Implement advanced monitoring and alerting (PMM, Ops Manager, Grafana, Datadog). Operational Excellence & Automation ● Automate backup/recovery (Xtra Backup, mysqldump/mysqlpump, Ops Manager, filesystem snapshots, MSSQL native tools). ● Champion Infrastructure‐as‐Code (Terraform, Ansible, Kubernetes Operators). ● Implement Change Data Capture (CDC) pipelines using Debezium and integrate with downstream systems. ● Enforce strong security: authentication, authorization, encryption, auditing. ● Conduct DR drills, capacity planning, and maintain clear documentation/runbooks. ● Continuously reduce operational toil through automation and engineering solutions. Collaboration & Incident Response ● Partner with Dev Ops/SRE teams to integrate DB ops into CI/CD pipelines. ● Mentor engineers on database best practices. ● Participate in on‐call rotations, lead incident response, and write clear, blameless RCAs. ● Work closely with product and platform teams to influence system design through the lens of scale, resilience, and cost efficiency. What We’re Looking For Core Engineering ● Strong foundations in Linux/Unix, networking (DNS, TCP/IP), and distributed systems. ● Proficiency in Python, Bash, or Java Script for automation and tooling. ● Clean Git practices and strong software engineering discipline. Databases ● Deep expertise in My SQL and Mongo DB. ● Proven experience with HA/DR setups, replication, and performance tuning. ● Backup/recovery expertise with Xtra Backup, mongodump, Ops Manager, MSSQL native tools. ● Working knowledge of Postgre SQL, Redis, Elasticsearch, Cassandra, and Big Query. ● Experience building and operating CDC pipelines with Debezium. Infrastructure & Tooling ● Infrastructure as Code using Terraform (required). ● Configuration and automation using Ansible/Chef (preferred). ● CI/CD integration with Jenkins, Git Lab CI, Git Hub Actions. Observability & Reliability ● Metrics and alerting: PMM, Prometheus, Grafana, Alertmanager. ● Tracing/APM: Datadog, New Relic, Open Telemetry. ● Incident management experience (Pager Duty or equivalent). Nice to Have ● Experience with managed database services (AWS RDS/Aurora, Mongo DB Atlas, Big Query). ● Exposure to Dev Sec Ops and cloud security. ● Experience operating high‐traffic, consumer‐facing systems. ● Relevant certifications (Mongo DB Certified DBA, Oracle My SQL DBA, MSSQL certifications). ● Strong written communication (design docs, RFCs, runbooks). What Success Looks Like at Lenskart ● Databases that are reliable, scalable, and boring in production. ● Faster delivery with fewer incidents. ● Strong developer trust in the data platform. ● Systems that scale seamlessly with business growth. Why Lenskart ● Real‐world scale with tangible customer impact. ● Strong engineering ownership and autonomy. ● Opportunity to shape data platforms used across the company. ● A culture that values craft, clarity, and engineering excellence.

title: Commercial Leader
jobDescription:
Mission Brief: Build Lenskart's Commercial Engine This is a high-impact leadership role focused on transforming how Lenskart buys, negotiates, and manages every rupee of external spend across manufacturing, retail, and corporate categories. You will be the architect of a tech-led, AI-first commercial function that turns procurement from a cost center into a structural margin and growth lever. Lenskart spends across hundreds of categories, thousands of suppliers, and multiple geographies and that footprint is compounding as we scale globally. Your mission is to build the systems, frameworks, and team that convert this spend into a durable competitive advantage: delivering step-change cost savings while making procurement faster, more transparent, and more intelligent than anyone else in the industry. This is your canvas to define what modern commercial leadership looks like and to build something that outlasts you. 🔑 Core Mandate: Commercial Transformation & Value Creation
1. Commercial Intelligence Platform (The Builder's Focus) Platform Visionary: Own the strategic vision and rollout of Lenskart's commercial intelligence stack — should-cost models, spend analytics, supplier scorecards, e-sourcing, contract lifecycle, and AI-assisted negotiation insights — moving procurement from spreadsheets and email threads to a real-time decision engine. Technical Partnership: Act as the primary business lead, translating sourcing and category requirements into actionable specifications for Tech, Data Science, and Finance Systems teams. Drive enterprise-grade ERP, S2P, and analytics adoption across the function. Systems Design Ownership: Define the logic for category strategies, approval workflows, vendor risk scoring, and exception-based management — so that the majority of routine decisions are system-guided and only true exceptions reach human review. AI-First Operating Model: Embed AI and ML into every layer of the function — supplier discovery, price prediction, contract intelligence, negotiation playbooks. Set the bar for what an AI-native procurement org looks like.
2. Strategic Sourcing & P&L Impact (The Business Focus) Margin Impact: Directly influence gross margin and EBITDA through strategic sourcing, negotiations, demand consolidation, and value engineering across manufacturing inputs, retail spend (store Cap Ex and Op Ex, marketing, logistics), and corporate categories. Year-on-Year P&L Delivery: Own and deliver structural year-on-year Store EBITDA cost savings benchmarked to the best in the industry — step-change, not incremental. Should-Cost & TCO Discipline: Make should-cost, total-cost-of-ownership, and value engineering the default lens for every major category decision — embedded in tools and workflows, not one-off exercises. Supplier Ecosystem: Build a supplier base optimized for cost, quality, speed, and resilience. Drive localization, alternate sourcing, and dual-sourcing strategies to de-risk global supply volatility. Strategic Buying: Transition the team from tactical PO-pushing to strategic oversight — system-generated demand signals, dynamic category playbooks, and contracts linked to real-time business KPIs. Negotiation Excellence: Be the commercial sharpshooter at the table for the highest-stakes negotiations — and build a team that negotiates with the same rigor.
3. Cross-Functional Leadership & Adoption Change Agent: Lead the cultural and technical adoption of the new commercial platform across Finance, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Retail, and Marketing. Enforce a data-driven, evidence-led decision-making culture and challenge entrenched ways of working. Commercial Voice: Be the commercial conscience in planning, budgeting, and capital allocation forums. Bring rigor to make-vs-buy, vendor selection, and Cap Ex decisions across the business. Team Building: Build, mentor, and develop a high-performing commercial team spanning category leaders, sourcing analysts, and platform owners — and create the next generation of commercial leaders for the industry. The Essentials: Experience: Proven leadership in procurement, strategic sourcing, or commercial roles, with proven ownership of end-to-end procurement across manufacturing, retail, and corporate spend. Exposure to global or multi-country sourcing is a strong plus. Commercial Track Record: Proven history of delivering breakthrough — not incremental — cost savings through strategic sourcing, negotiation, and value engineering at scale. Consistent year-on-year P&L impact, benchmarked against the best in the industry. Negotiation Mastery: Track record of leading complex, high-stakes negotiations and building negotiation discipline into the broader team. Tech & AI Acumen: Familiarity with enterprise procurement platforms and an open, curious mindset toward leveraging data, ML, and AI in commercial decision-making. A willingness to learn and partner with tech teams matters more than deep technical expertise.

EDUCATION:
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, or a quantitative field; MBA preferred. 🧠 The Mindset: Systems & Product Thinking: You see procurement as a product to be built, not a queue to be cleared. You're as comfortable specifying a sourcing platform with engineers as you are negotiating with a Tier-1 supplier. Analytical Rigor & Speed: You thrive on spend data, supplier benchmarks, and cost models. You move at the pace of a high-growth tech company — fast, decisive, willing to ship a V1 and improve it. Transformational Leadership: You're a compelling commercial voice — capable of driving change across functions, securing alignment from CXOs to category managers, and developing the next generation of commercial talent. Hands-On & Outcome-Driven: You don't outsource the hard parts. You're in the room for the toughest negotiations, the messiest data, and the most stuck stakeholders — and you deliver outcomes, not decks. Tech-First & AI-First Operator: You default to automation, data, and intelligent systems. You believe the next generation of commercial leaders will be defined by how well they harness AI and you're already building that way. title: Buying Planning & Merchandise Lead
jobDescription: About Lenskart Lenskart is a tech-led, omni-channel eyewear company with a growing footprint across India and international markets. We operate an integrated value chain across design, manufacturing, retail, and e-commerce. Role Overview The Buying Planning & Merchandise Lead will own the flow of merchandise from vendor to warehouse across all categories and regions. The role is anchored in demand forecasting, OTB, vendor capacity planning, and lead-time reduction — ensuring the right quantity of the right product reaches the right warehouse at the right time, at the right cost. Key Responsibilities Demand Forecasting Own global demand forecasting across categories, channels, and regions. Drive forecast accuracy through structured S&OP cycles, sell-through analysis, and seasonality modelling. Translate top-down financial plans and bottom-up category plans into a single, executable demand view. OTB & Buying Planning Own the Open-to-Buy (OTB) process — building, tracking, and re-forecasting through the season. Manage inflow planning, phasing, and depth-vs-breadth decisions in line with sales, stock, and margin targets. Partner with the buying and category teams to convert assortment plans into actionable buy quantities. Vendor Capacity Planning Lead capacity planning with the vendor base — aligning monthly and weekly production capacity with the demand plan. Work with sourcing and manufacturing partners to lock capacity ahead of peak periods and manage flex during demand swings. Build visibility into vendor performance on capacity, on-time delivery, and fill rates. Lead-Time Reduction & Inflow Drive reduction of lead times across the vendor-to-warehouse cycle through better planning rhythm, order release discipline, and vendor collaboration. Improve PO-to-receipt timelines, in-transit visibility, and warehouse inbound predictability. Work with logistics and warehousing teams to smooth inflow and reduce bullwhip across the network. Inventory & Allocation Own inventory health across warehouses — turns, cover, ageing, and excess. Drive allocation and replenishment models that maintain availability with controlled markdowns. Collaboration & Leadership Work closely with Buying, Sourcing, Manufacturing, Logistics, Retail, E-commerce, and Finance. Build and lead a strong planning and merch supply chain team. Key Requirements Relevant experience in demand planning, merchandise planning, OTB, or merchandise supply chain roles. Strong grounding in demand forecasting, OTB, vendor capacity planning, and lead-time management. Commercial understanding of inventory turns, fill rates, markdowns, and working capital. Hands-on with planning and analytics tools (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Anaplan, or equivalent). Experience working with vendor networks and cross-functional supply chain teams. Comfortable operating in a fast-moving, data-led environment. Why Join Lenskart Own the end-to-end merchandise flow from vendor to warehouse at scale. Operate at the intersection of planning, supply chain, and commercial strategy. Work in a data-led, digitally native environment with international scope.
